svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 294 mm of 20 mm ground stainless bar; face both ends

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: square and chamfer them 1 mm so the bearings slide on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check the bar slides through a bearing unit by hand; polish any

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No keyways: the runner hub and coupling clamp the shaft, and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bearing inserts lock with their own set screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: At assembly, spot each set screw into the shaft with a 5 mm drill

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 0.5 mm deep through the screw hole, then tighten.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: bottom end flush with the underside of the runner hub; top end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: half way into the jaw coupling, 30 mm above the upper bearing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: straight within 0.1 mm over its length (roll it on glass).
